Aabhogi.name: Aabhogi
Aabhogi.arohana: S R2 G2 M1 D2 S'
Aabhogi.avarohana: S' D2 M1 G2 R2 S
Aabhogi.explanation: An Audava-Audava pentatonic raga omitting Pa and Ni. Known for its symmetrical, pleasing structure.

Aahiri.name: Aahiri
Aahiri.arohana: S R1 S G2 M1 P D1 N2 S'
Aahiri.avarohana: S' N2 D1 P M1 G2 R1 S
Aahiri.explanation: A rare, profoundly melancholic vakra bhashanga raga capable of inducing deep sadness and catharsis.

Aanandhaambari.name: Aanandhaambari
Aanandhaambari.arohana: S R2 G3 M1 P D2 N2 S'
Aanandhaambari.avarohana: S' N2 D2 P M1 G3 R2 S
Aanandhaambari.explanation: Melodious janya evoking serene bliss and devotional warmth.

Aandholika.name: Aandholika
Aandholika.arohana: S R2 M1 P N2 S'
Aandholika.avarohana: S' N2 D2 M1 R2 S
Aandholika.explanation: Named after the swinging motion (andolika / palanquin), omitting Gandhara in ascent.

Aarabhi.name: Aarabhi
Aarabhi.arohana: S R2 M1 P D2 S'
Aarabhi.avarohana: S' N3 D2 P M1 G3 R2 S
Aarabhi.explanation: One of the five major Ghana ragas of Carnatic music. Featured in Saint Thyagaraja's Pancharatna Kriti 'Sadhinchane'.

Ahir Bhairavi.name: Ahir Bhairavi
Ahir Bhairavi.arohana: S R1 G3 M1 P D2 N2 S'
Ahir Bhairavi.avarohana: S' N2 D2 P M1 G3 R1 S
Ahir Bhairavi.rasaOrMood: Dawn Awakening, Serious Devotion, Meditative Calm
Ahir Bhairavi.explanation: A compound scale blending Bhairav in the lower tetrachord and Kafi in the upper tetrachord.

Airavathi.name: Airavathi
Airavathi.arohana: S R1 G2 M2 P D1 S'
Airavathi.avarohana: S' D1 P M2 G2 R1 S
Airavathi.explanation: Named after Indra's divine elephant, an evocative pentatonic janya with Prati Madhyamam.

Amrithavarshini.name: Amrithavarshini
Amrithavarshini.arohana: S R2 G3 M2 P N3 S'
Amrithavarshini.avarohana: S' N3 P M2 G3 R2 S
Amrithavarshini.explanation: Famous for the legend of Muthuswami Dikshitar bringing rain at Ettayapuram with his kriti 'Anandamrutakarshini'.

Ananda Bhairavi.name: Ananda Bhairavi
Ananda Bhairavi.arohana: S G2 R2 G2 M1 P D2 P S'
Ananda Bhairavi.avarohana: S' N2 D2 P M1 G2 R2 S
Ananda Bhairavi.explanation: An ancient, highly auspicious vakra bhashanga raga featuring distinct ornamentation on Gandhara and Nishada.

Atana.name: Atana
Atana.arohana: S R2 M1 P N3 S'
Atana.avarohana: S' N3 D2 P M1 P G3 R2 S
Atana.explanation: Celebrated for its sparkling phrases in the high octave and assertive, spirited character.

Bahudhari.name: Bahudhari
Bahudhari.arohana: S G3 M1 P D2 N2 S'
Bahudhari.avarohana: S' N2 D2 P M1 G3 S
Bahudhari.explanation: A sparkling Shadava-Audava raga omitting Rishabham, famous for G.N. Balasubramaniam's 'Brova Barama'.

Bahumarini.name: Bahumarini
Bahumarini.arohana: S R2 G3 M1 P D2 N2 S'
Bahumarini.avarohana: S' N2 D2 P M1 G3 R2 S
Bahumarini.explanation: Rare melodic scale popularized by Berny Ignatius in the movie Chess for 'Chandam Kaalindi'.

Basanth Bahar.name: Basanth Bahar
Basanth Bahar.arohana: S G3 M2 P D1 N3 S'
Basanth Bahar.avarohana: S' N2 D2 P M1 G2 M1 R2 S
Basanth Bahar.explanation: A celebrated Hindustani jod (compound) raga uniting the joyful spring moods of Raga Basant and Raga Bahar.

Begada.name: Begada
Begada.arohana: S G3 R2 G3 M1 P D2 P S'
Begada.avarohana: S' N3 D2 P M1 G3 R2 S
Begada.rasaOrMood: Shringara, Regal Majestic Devotion, Argumentative Wit
Begada.explanation: Known as the 'King of ragas' for intellectual mastery, featuring unique characteristic oscillation on Madhyamam.

Bhaathiyaar.name: Bhaathiyaar
Bhaathiyaar.arohana: S D1 P, M2 D1 S'
Bhaathiyaar.avarohana: S' r1 N3 D1 P, M2 P G3, M1 R1 S
Bhaathiyaar.explanation: A profound early-morning Hindustani melody incorporating both Madhyamas and Komal Rishabh.

Bhagesri.name: Bhagesri
Bhagesri.arohana: S G2 M1 D2 N2 S'
Bhagesri.avarohana: S' N2 D2 M1 P D2 G2 M1 R2 S
Bhagesri.explanation: Deep, soothing late-night raga expressing intimate romantic longing.

Bhairavi.name: Bhairavi
Bhairavi.arohana: S G2 R2 G2 M1 P D2 N2 S'
Bhairavi.avarohana: S' N2 D1 P M1 G2 R1 S
Bhairavi.explanation: The queen of Carnatic ragas, a Bhashanga scale using both Chatusruti Dhaivata and Suddha Dhaivata.

Bheem Plaasi.name: Bheem Plaasi
Bheem Plaasi.arohana: n2' S G2 M1 P n2 S'
Bheem Plaasi.avarohana: S' n2 D2 P M1 G2 R2 S
Bheem Plaasi.explanation: A sublime afternoon raga with deep resonance on Shuddha Ma and Komal Ga.

Bheemplaas.name: Bheemplaas
Bheemplaas.arohana: S G2 M1 P N2 S'
Bheemplaas.avarohana: S' N2 D2 P M1 G2 R2 S
Bheemplaas.explanation: Common spelling variation of Bhimpalasi extensively documented in cinema music archives.

Bhoopalam.name: Bhoopalam
Bhoopalam.arohana: S R1 G2 P D1 S'
Bhoopalam.avarohana: S' D1 P G2 R1 S
Bhoopalam.explanation: Sacred dawn raga sung in temples during Nirmalya Darshanam to awaken the deity.

Bihag.name: Bihag
Bihag.arohana: S G3 M1 P N3 S'
Bihag.avarohana: S' N3 D2 P M2 G3 M1 G3 R2 S
Bihag.timeOfDay: Second Quarter of Night (9 PM - 12 AM)
Bihag.explanation: Celebrated romantic raga that introduces Teevra Ma delicately in descent.

Bilahari.name: Bilahari
Bilahari.arohana: S R2 G3 P D2 S'
Bilahari.avarohana: S' N3 D2 P M1 G3 R2 S
Bilahari.explanation: Audava-Sampoorna scale with Mohanam ascent and Sankarabharanam descent. Evokes vibrant optimism.

Bilawal.name: Bilawal
Bilawal.arohana: S R2 G3 P D2 N3 S'
Bilawal.avarohana: S' N3 D2 P M1 G3 R2 S
Bilawal.explanation: The shuddha scale of modern Hindustani classical music corresponding to Western Major Scale.

Bindumaalini.name: Bindumaalini
Bindumaalini.arohana: S G3 R1 G3 M1 P N2 S'
Bindumaalini.avarohana: S' N2 S' D2 P G3 R1 S
Bindumaalini.explanation: Popularized by Saint Thyagaraja's immortal kriti 'Entha Muddo Enta Sogaso'.

Bowli.name: Bowli
Bowli.arohana: S R1 G3 P D1 S'
Bowli.avarohana: S' N3 D1 P G3 R1 S
Bowli.explanation: A morning raga omitting Madhyamam, famously chosen for Annamacharya's 'Brahmam Okkate'.

Chalanaatta.name: Chalanaatta
Chalanaatta.arohana: S R3 G3 M1 P D3 N3 S'
Chalanaatta.avarohana: S' N3 D3 P M1 G3 R3 S
Chalanaatta.explanation: The 36th and final Suddha Madhyama Melakarta with Shatsruti Rishabha and Shatsruti Dhaivata.

Chandra Kouns.name: Chandra Kouns
Chandra Kouns.arohana: S G2 M1 D1 N3 S'
Chandra Kouns.avarohana: S' N3 D1 M1 G2 S
Chandra Kouns.explanation: Formed by replacing Kaisiki Nishadha in Malkauns with Kakali Nishadha (N3), creating a sparkling glow.

Chenchurutti.name: Chenchurutti
Chenchurutti.arohana: D2 S R2 G3 M1 P D2 N2
Chenchurutti.avarohana: N2 D2 P M1 G3 R2 S N2 D2
Chenchurutti.explanation: A folk-origin scale usually sung in Mandra/Madhya stayi, famous for javalis, bhajans and Kavadi Chindu.

Chitta Ranjini.name: Chitta Ranjini
Chitta Ranjini.arohana: S R2 G2 M1 P D1 N1 S'
Chitta Ranjini.avarohana: S' N1 D1 P M1 G2 R2 S
Chitta Ranjini.explanation: Thyagaraja's gem 'Nada Thanumanisam' is immortalized in this scale.

Darbari Kaanada.name: Darbari Kaanada
Darbari Kaanada.arohana: S R2 G2 M1 P D1 N2 S'
Darbari Kaanada.avarohana: S' D1 N2 P M1 P G2 M1 R2 S
Darbari Kaanada.explanation: Emperor Akbar's royal court raga, characterized by slow andolans on Komal Ga and Komal Dha.

Desh.name: Desh
Desh.arohana: S R2 M1 P N3 S'
Desh.avarohana: S' N2 D2 P M1 G3 R2 S
Desh.timeOfDay: Late Evening / Second Prahar of Night
Desh.explanation: Famous national melody of 'Vande Mataram', featuring Kakali Ni in ascent and Kaisiki Ni in descent.

Devagandhari.name: Devagandhari
Devagandhari.arohana: S R2 M1 P D2 S'
Devagandhari.avarohana: S' N3 D2 P M1 G3 R2 S
Devagandhari.explanation: Allied with Arabhi but distinguished by slower tempo, prolonged Gandhara with kampita gamaka.

Devamanohari.name: Devamanohari
Devamanohari.arohana: S R2 M1 P D2 N2 S'
Devamanohari.avarohana: S' N2 D2 N2 P M1 R2 S
Devamanohari.explanation: Pleasing Janya omitting Gandhara, noted for its vakra descent N2 D2 N2 P M1.

Dhanakaapi.name: Dhanakaapi
Dhanakaapi.arohana: S R2 M1 P N3 S'
Dhanakaapi.avarohana: S' N2 D2 P M1 G2 R2 S
Dhanakaapi.explanation: A melodic shade of Raga Kapi with heightened tender appeal.

Dhanasri.name: Dhanasri
Dhanasri.arohana: S G2 M1 P N2 S'
Dhanasri.avarohana: S' N2 D2 P M1 G2 R2 S
Dhanasri.explanation: Swathi Thirunal composed his famous Thillana 'Geeta Dhuniku Taka' in Dhanashree.

Dhanyasi.name: Dhanyasi
Dhanyasi.arohana: S G2 M1 P N2 S'
Dhanyasi.avarohana: S' N2 D1 P M1 G2 R1 S
Dhanyasi.explanation: Audava-Sampoorna morning raga omitting Ri and Dha in ascent.

Dharmavathi.name: Dharmavathi
Dharmavathi.arohana: S R2 G2 M2 P D2 N3 S'
Dharmavathi.avarohana: S' N3 D2 P M2 G2 R2 S
Dharmavathi.explanation: The 59th Melakarta raga with Prati Madhyamam, closely related to Hindustani Madhuvanti.

Dhenuka.name: Dhenuka
Dhenuka.arohana: S R1 G2 M1 P D1 N3 S'
Dhenuka.avarohana: S' N3 D1 P M1 G2 R1 S
Dhenuka.explanation: The 9th Melakarta raga characterized by Kakali Nishadha alongside Suddha Dhaivata.

Durga.name: Durga
Durga.arohana: S R2 M1 P D2 S'
Durga.avarohana: S' D2 P M1 R2 S
Durga.rasaOrMood: Innocent Joy, Serene Splendour, Motherly Grace
Durga.timeOfDay: Second Prahar of Night (9 PM - Midnight)
Durga.explanation: Pentatonic scale omitting Ga and Ni, evoking pristine purity and courage.

Dwijavanthi.name: Dwijavanthi
Dwijavanthi.arohana: S R2 M1 P D2 S'
Dwijavanthi.avarohana: S' N2 D2 P M1 G3 M1 R2 G2 R2 S
Dwijavanthi.explanation: Exquisite Bhashanga raga employing both Gandharas (G2 and G3).

Gambheera Naatta.name: Gambheera Naatta
Gambheera Naatta.arohana: S G3 M1 P N3 S'
Gambheera Naatta.avarohana: S' N3 P M1 G3 S
Gambheera Naatta.explanation: Pentatonic scale omitting Ri and Dha, celebrated for majestic temple procession compositions.

Gara.name: Gara
Gara.arohana: S G3 M1 P D2 N3 S'
Gara.avarohana: S' N2 D2 P M1 G2 R2 S
Gara.explanation: Light classical Hindustani raga frequently used in semi-classical Ghazals and Thumris.

Gavathi.name: Gavathi
Gavathi.arohana: S G3 M1 P D2 S'
Gavathi.avarohana: S' N2 D2 P M1 G3 M1 R2 S
Gavathi.explanation: Modern Hindustani scale omitting Rishabh in ascent.

Gowla.name: Gowla
Gowla.arohana: S R1 M1 P N3 S'
Gowla.avarohana: S' N3 P M1 R1 G3 M1 R1 S
Gowla.explanation: One of the sacred Ghana Panchaka ragas, famous for Thyagaraja's 'Duduku Gala'.

Gowli Panthu.name: Gowli Panthu
Gowli Panthu.arohana: S R1 M1 P N3 S'
Gowli Panthu.avarohana: S' N3 D1 P M1 D1 M1 G3 R1 S
Gowli Panthu.explanation: Thyagaraja's poignant 'Tera Teeyagarada' is immortalized in this scale.

Gowri Manohari.name: Gowri Manohari
Gowri Manohari.arohana: S R2 G2 M1 P D2 N3 S'
Gowri Manohari.avarohana: S' N3 D2 P M1 G2 R2 S
Gowri Manohari.explanation: The 23rd Melakarta raga, corresponding to the Western Melodic Minor scale in ascent.

Gunji Kaanada.name: Gunji Kaanada
Gunji Kaanada.arohana: S R2 G2 M1 P D1 N2 S'
Gunji Kaanada.avarohana: S' D1 N2 P M1 P G2 M1 R2 S
Gunji Kaanada.explanation: A rare and tender variation of the Kanada family.

Hamsanaadam.name: Hamsanaadam
Hamsanaadam.arohana: S R2 M2 P N3 S'
Hamsanaadam.avarohana: S' N3 P M2 R2 S
Hamsanaadam.explanation: Pentatonic scale omitting Ga and Dha, immortalized in Thyagaraja's 'Bantureethi Koluvu'.

Hamsanadam.name: Hamsanadam
Hamsanadam.arohana: S R2 M2 P N3 S'
Hamsanadam.avarohana: S' N3 P M2 R2 S

Hamsanandi.name: Hamsanandi
Hamsanandi.arohana: S R1 G3 M2 D2 N3 S'
Hamsanandi.avarohana: S' N3 D2 M2 G3 R1 S
Hamsanandi.rasaOrMood: Dusk Mystery, Poignant Yearning, Spiritual Calm
Hamsanandi.explanation: Hexatonic raga omitting Panchama, casting an enchanting, mystical twilight hue.

Harikamboji.name: Harikamboji
Harikamboji.arohana: S R2 G3 M1 P D2 N2 S'
Harikamboji.avarohana: S' N2 D2 P M1 G3 R2 S
Harikamboji.explanation: The 28th Melakarta raga and the fountainhead of numerous beloved ragas including Mohanam, Kamboji, and Sahana.

Hemavathi.name: Hemavathi
Hemavathi.arohana: S R2 G2 M2 P D2 N2 S'
Hemavathi.avarohana: S' N2 D2 P M2 G2 R2 S
Hemavathi.explanation: The 58th Melakarta raga, symmetrical and highly expressive with Prati Madhyamam.

Jaganmohini.name: Jaganmohini
Jaganmohini.arohana: S G3 M1 P N3 S'
Jaganmohini.avarohana: S' N3 P M1 G3 R1 S
Jaganmohini.rasaOrMood: Enchanting the Universe (Jagan-Mohini), Awe, Divine Splendour
Jaganmohini.explanation: Famous for Thyagaraja's 'Sobhillu Saptaswara', omitting Rishabha in ascent.

Jaijaiwanti.name: Jaijaiwanti
Jaijaiwanti.arohana: R2 G2 R2 S, N3' S D2' N2' P' R2, G3 M1 P
Jaijaiwanti.avarohana: S' N2 D2 P M1 G3 M1 R2 G2 R2 S
Jaijaiwanti.explanation: Celebrated romantic Hindustani classical raga with subtle transitions between both Gandharas.

Jana Ranjini.name: Jana Ranjini
Jana Ranjini.arohana: S R2 G3 M1 P D2 P N3 S'
Jana Ranjini.avarohana: S' D2 P M1 R2 S
Jana Ranjini.explanation: Famous for Muthuswami Dikshitar's 'Pahimam Sri Rajarajeswari'.

Janasammodini.name: Janasammodini
Janasammodini.arohana: S R2 G3 P D2 N2 S'
Janasammodini.avarohana: S' N2 D2 P G3 R2 S
Janasammodini.explanation: Omits Madhyamam, providing a sweet blend of Mohanam and Harikambhoji.

Japaniya.name: Japaniya
Japaniya.arohana: S R1 M1 P N2 S'
Japaniya.avarohana: S' N2 P M1 R1 S
Japaniya.explanation: Pentatonic scale with East Asian nuances adapted into cinema music by Raveendran Master.

Jayanthasri.name: Jayanthasri
Jayanthasri.arohana: S G2 M1 D1 N2 S'
Jayanthasri.avarohana: S' N2 D1 M1 P M1 G2 S
Jayanthasri.explanation: Immortalized in Thyagaraja's 'Marugelara O Raghava', omitting Rishabham.

Jonpuri.name: Jonpuri
Jonpuri.arohana: S R2 M1 P D1 N2 S'
Jonpuri.avarohana: S' N2 D1 P M1 G2 R2 S
Jonpuri.explanation: Created by Sultan Hussain Sharqi of Jaunpur, very popular in classical recitals and cinema.

Kadana Kudoohalam.name: Kadana Kudoohalam
Kadana Kudoohalam.arohana: S R2 M1 D2 N3 G3 P S'
Kadana Kudoohalam.avarohana: S' N3 D2 P M1 G3 R2 S
Kadana Kudoohalam.explanation: Invented by Patnam Subramania Iyer, celebrated for its buoyant, leaping ascent.

Kalavathi.name: Kalavathi
Kalavathi.arohana: S R1 G3 P D2 S'
Kalavathi.avarohana: S' D2 P G3 R1 S
Kalavathi.explanation: A sweet pentatonic scale omitting Madhyamam and Nishadam.

Kalyana Vasantham.name: Kalyana Vasantham
Kalyana Vasantham.arohana: S G2 M1 D1 N3 S'
Kalyana Vasantham.avarohana: S' N3 D1 P M1 G2 R2 S
Kalyana Vasantham.explanation: Famous for Thyagaraja's 'Nadale Leda', combining Keeravani notes with Chandrakauns ascent.

Kamboji.name: Kamboji
Kamboji.arohana: S R2 G3 M1 P D2 S'
Kamboji.avarohana: S' N2 D2 P M1 G3 R2 S
Kamboji.explanation: One of the grandest ragas of Carnatic music, capable of endless elaboration.

Kanakaangi.name: Kanakaangi
Kanakaangi.arohana: S R1 G1 M1 P D1 N1 S'
Kanakaangi.avarohana: S' N1 D1 P M1 G1 R1 S
Kanakaangi.explanation: The very first Melakarta of the 72-Melakarta scheme, using pure shuddha swaras throughout.

Kannada Gowla.name: Kannada Gowla
Kannada Gowla.arohana: S R2 G2 M1 P N2 S'
Kannada Gowla.avarohana: S' N2 D2 P M1 G2 S
Kannada Gowla.explanation: Thyagaraja's 'Ora Jupuju' is famously composed in this scale.

Kapi Narayani.name: Kapi Narayani
Kapi Narayani.arohana: S R2 M1 P D2 N2 S'
Kapi Narayani.avarohana: S' N2 D2 P M1 G3 R2 S
Kapi Narayani.explanation: Audava-Sampoorna raga omitting Gandhara in ascent.

Karnaranjani.name: Karnaranjani
Karnaranjani.arohana: S R2 G2 M1 P D2 S'
Karnaranjani.avarohana: S' N2 D2 P M1 G2 R2 S
Karnaranjani.rasaOrMood: Pleasing to the Ear (Karna-Ranjani), Tender Beauty
Karnaranjani.explanation: Created by Muthiah Bhagavathar, famous for 'Om Namo Narayana'.

Karnataka Bihag.name: Karnataka Bihag
Karnataka Bihag.arohana: S R2 G3 M1 P D2 N2 S'
Karnataka Bihag.avarohana: S' N2 D2 P M1 G3 R2 S
Karnataka Bihag.explanation: Carnatic traditional adaptation of Bihag with regional characteristics.

Karnataka Devagandhari.name: Karnataka Devagandhari
Karnataka Devagandhari.arohana: S G2 M1 P N2 S'
Karnataka Devagandhari.avarohana: S' N2 D2 P M1 G2 R2 S
Karnataka Devagandhari.explanation: Often treated identically or very close to Raga Abheri.

Karnataka Kaapi.name: Karnataka Kaapi
Karnataka Kaapi.arohana: S R2 G2 M1 P D2 N2 S'
Karnataka Kaapi.avarohana: S' N2 D2 P M1 G2 R2 S
Karnataka Kaapi.explanation: The traditional Carnatic form of Kapi before North Indian influences were integrated.

Karnataka Khamas.name: Karnataka Khamas
Karnataka Khamas.arohana: S M1 G3 M1 P D2 N2 S'
Karnataka Khamas.avarohana: S' N2 D2 P M1 G3 R2 S
Karnataka Khamas.explanation: Traditional Carnatic treatment of Khamas without Kakali Nishadha.

Kedar.name: Kedar
Kedar.arohana: S M1, M1 P, D2 P S'
Kedar.avarohana: S' N3 D2 P, M2 P D2 P M1, S R2 S
Kedar.rasaOrMood: Devotion, Peaceful Majesty, Lord Shiva's Grace
Kedar.explanation: Named after Lord Shiva (Kedarnath), distinctive for its striking leap from Sa to Shuddha Ma.

Kedara Gowla.name: Kedara Gowla
Kedara Gowla.arohana: S R2 M1 P N3 S'
Kedara Gowla.avarohana: S' N2 D2 P M1 G3 R2 S
Kedara Gowla.explanation: Features Kakali Ni in ascent and Kaisiki Ni in descent, creating a tranquil, reverent atmosphere.

Kedaram.name: Kedaram
Kedaram.arohana: S M1 G3 M1 P N3 S'
Kedaram.avarohana: S' N3 P M1 G3 R2 S
Kedaram.explanation: Features vakra phrase S M1 G3 M1 P and omits Dhaivatam, producing sweet spiritual elevation.

Khamas.name: Khamas
Khamas.arohana: S M1 G3 M1 P D2 N2 S'
Khamas.avarohana: S' N2 D2 P M1 G3 R2 S
Khamas.rasaOrMood: Shringara (Romantic Romance), Tender Charm, Playful Joy
Khamas.timeOfDay: Second Prahar of Night (9 PM - Midnight)
Khamas.explanation: Immortalized in Javadis, Padams, and classic film songs like 'Brochevarevarura'.

Kharahara Priya.name: Kharahara Priya
Kharahara Priya.arohana: S R2 G2 M1 P D2 N2 S'
Kharahara Priya.avarohana: S' N2 D2 P M1 G2 R2 S
Kharahara Priya.explanation: One of the most profound Major Melakarta ragas, parent to Abheri, Darbari Kanada, Kapi, and Madhyamavathi.

Kunthalavarali.name: Kunthalavarali
Kunthalavarali.arohana: S M1 P D2 N2 D2 S'
Kunthalavarali.avarohana: S' N2 D2 P M1 S
Kunthalavarali.explanation: Pentatonic scale omitting Ri and Ga, famous in fast-paced thillanas and dance numbers like 'Oru Murai Vanthu'.

Lathaangi.name: Lathaangi
Lathaangi.arohana: S R2 G3 M2 P D1 N3 S'
Lathaangi.avarohana: S' N3 D1 P M2 G3 R2 S
Lathaangi.explanation: The 63rd Melakarta raga, combining Kalyani's purvanga with Kamavardhini's uttaranga.

Lavangi.name: Lavangi
Lavangi.explanation: An extremely rare 4-note (Swarantara) raga created by Dr. M. Balamuralikrishna omitting Ga, Pa, and Ni.

Maanji.name: Maanji
Maanji.arohana: S R2 G2 M1 P D2 N2 S'
Maanji.avarohana: S' N2 D1 P M1 G2 R2 S
Maanji.explanation: Close relative of Bhairavi, celebrated in Syama Sastri's 'Brovavamma' for its deeply moving lament.

Madhuvanthi.name: Madhuvanthi
Madhuvanthi.arohana: S G2 M2 P N3 S'
Madhuvanthi.avarohana: S' N3 D2 P M2 G2 R2 S
Madhuvanthi.explanation: Literally 'Sweet as Honey', utilizing Teevra Ma alongside Komal Ga to produce mesmerizing romantic poignancy.

Madhyamavarali.name: Madhyamavarali
Madhyamavarali.arohana: S R2 M1 P N2 S'
Madhyamavarali.avarohana: S' N2 P M1 R2 S
Madhyamavarali.explanation: Allied variation of Madhyamavathi used in traditional theatre and sopana sangeetham.

Malahari.name: Malahari
Malahari.arohana: S R1 M1 P D1 S'
Malahari.avarohana: S' D1 P M1 G3 R1 S
Malahari.rasaOrMood: Dispeller of Dirt (Mala-Hari), Morning Purity, Devotion
Malahari.explanation: Purandara Dasa chose this raga for foundational beginner Geethams like 'Sri Gananatha'.

Manavathi.name: Manavathi
Manavathi.arohana: S R1 G1 M1 P D2 N3 S'
Manavathi.avarohana: S' N3 D2 P M1 G1 R1 S
Manavathi.explanation: The 5th Melakarta raga in the Venkatamakhin scheme.

Manirang.name: Manirang
Manirang.arohana: S R2 M1 P N2 S'
Manirang.avarohana: S' N2 P M1 G2 R2 S
Manirang.explanation: Audava-Shadava raga allied with Madhyamavathi, adding Sadharana Gandharam in descent.

Manolayam.name: Manolayam
Manolayam.arohana: S R2 G2 M1 P D2 S'
Manolayam.avarohana: S' D2 P M1 G2 R2 S
Manolayam.explanation: Rare peaceful scale evoking deep mental stillness.

Marga Hindolam.name: Marga Hindolam
Marga Hindolam.arohana: S R2 G2 M1 P D1 N2 S'
Marga Hindolam.avarohana: S' N2 D1 M1 P M1 G2 R2 S
Marga Hindolam.explanation: Thyagaraja's 'Chalamelara' is immortalized in this scale.

Mayashree.name: Mayashree
Mayashree.arohana: S R1 G3 M1 P D1 N3 S'
Mayashree.avarohana: S' N3 D1 P M1 G3 R1 S

Megh.name: Megh
Megh.arohana: S R2 M1 P N2 S'
Megh.avarohana: S' N2 P M1 R2 S
Megh.rasaOrMood: Monsoon Thunder, Rain Joy, Divine Majesty
Megh.explanation: Ancient seasonal rain raga closely corresponding to Carnatic Madhyamavathi.

Misra Keeravani.name: Misra Keeravani
Misra Keeravani.arohana: S R2 G2 M1 P D1 N3 S'
Misra Keeravani.avarohana: S' N3 D1 P M1 G2 R2 S
Misra Keeravani.explanation: Keeravani embellished with touches of Komal Ni or Shuddha Dha in light classical expression.

Misra Khamas.name: Misra Khamas
Misra Khamas.arohana: S M1 G3 M1 P D2 N2 S'
Misra Khamas.avarohana: S' N2 D2 P M1 G3 R2 S
Misra Khamas.explanation: Embellished form of Khamas incorporating both Nishadhas in expressive semi-classical thumri songs.

Misra Peelu.name: Misra Peelu
Misra Peelu.parentRaga: Pilu with all 12 notes used playfully
Misra Peelu.arohana: S G3 M1 P N3 S'
Misra Peelu.avarohana: S' N2 D2 P M1 G2 R2 S
Misra Peelu.explanation: One of the most versatile and beloved light-classical scales in Indian music.

Misra Sivaranjani.name: Misra Sivaranjani
Misra Sivaranjani.arohana: S R2 G2 P D2 S'
Misra Sivaranjani.avarohana: S' D2 P G2 R2 S
Misra Sivaranjani.explanation: Sivaranjani heightened with subtle foreign swara touches (like Shuddha Ga or Kakali Ni).

Miyan Ki Malhar.name: Miyan Ki Malhar
Miyan Ki Malhar.arohana: S R2 P, M1 P, N3 D2 N3 S'
Miyan Ki Malhar.avarohana: S' N2 P, M1 P, G2 M1 R2 S
Miyan Ki Malhar.explanation: Legendary rain raga composed by Miyan Tansen, celebrated for heavy oscillations on Komal Gandhar.

Mohana Kalyani.name: Mohana Kalyani
Mohana Kalyani.arohana: S R2 G3 P D2 S'
Mohana Kalyani.avarohana: S' N3 D2 P M2 G3 R2 S
Mohana Kalyani.explanation: A glorious fusion of Mohanam in ascent and Kalyani with Prati Madhyamam in descent.

Mukhari.name: Mukhari
Mukhari.arohana: S R2 M1 P N2 S'
Mukhari.avarohana: S' N2 D1 P M1 G2 R2 S
Mukhari.explanation: The historic symbol of tragedy and pathos in Carnatic music, capable of evoking tears.

Multani.name: Multani
Multani.arohana: N3' S G2 M2 P N3 S'
Multani.avarohana: S' N3 D1 P M2 G2 R1 S
Multani.rasaOrMood: Quiet Anguish, Spiritual Yearning, Intense Heat
Multani.explanation: A quintessential late afternoon Hindustani raga creating solemn introspective gravity.

Naatta Kurinji.name: Naatta Kurinji
Naatta Kurinji.arohana: S R2 G3 M1 N3 D2 N3 P D2 N3 S'
Naatta Kurinji.avarohana: S' N3 D2 M1 G3 S
Naatta Kurinji.explanation: Celebrated for its intricate, meandering vakra phrases and alluring, sensual charm.

Nadanamakriya.name: Nadanamakriya
Nadanamakriya.arohana: S R1 G3 M1 P D1 N3
Nadanamakriya.avarohana: N3 D1 P M1 G3 R1 S N3'
Nadanamakriya.explanation: A Nishadantya raga (scales do not exceed the upper Nishadha), sung for philosophical songs.

Nagagandhari.name: Nagagandhari
Nagagandhari.arohana: S R2 M1 G2 M1 P D1 N2 S'
Nagagandhari.avarohana: S' N2 D1 P M1 G2 R2 S
Nagagandhari.explanation: Rare Janya of Natabhairavi with subtle vakra movements.

Naganandini.name: Naganandini
Naganandini.arohana: S R3 G3 M1 P D1 N3 S'
Naganandini.avarohana: S' N3 D1 P M1 G3 R3 S
Naganandini.explanation: The 30th Melakarta raga featuring Shatsruti Rishabha.

Nalinakanthi.name: Nalinakanthi
Nalinakanthi.arohana: S G3 R2 M1 P N3 S'
Nalinakanthi.avarohana: S' N3 P M1 G3 R2 S
Nalinakanthi.explanation: A sparkling, lively raga omitting Dhaivatam, famous for Thyagaraja's 'Manavyalakim'.

Narayani.name: Narayani
Narayani.arohana: S R2 M1 P D2 S'
Narayani.avarohana: S' N2 D2 P M1 G3 R2 S
Narayani.explanation: Audava-Sampoorna raga omitting Gandhara and Nishada in ascent.

Narthaki.name: Narthaki
Narthaki.arohana: S R2 G2 M1 P D2 N2 S'
Narthaki.avarohana: S' N2 D2 P M1 G2 R2 S
Narthaki.explanation: Named after the classical dancer (Narthaki), featured in Devarajan Master compositions.

Nasikabhushani.name: Nasikabhushani
Nasikabhushani.arohana: S R1 G3 M2 P D2 N3 S'
Nasikabhushani.avarohana: S' N3 D2 P M2 G3 R1 S
Nasikabhushani.explanation: The 70th Melakarta raga in the Carnatic system.

Natabhairavi.name: Natabhairavi
Natabhairavi.arohana: S R2 G2 M1 P D1 N2 S'
Natabhairavi.avarohana: S' N2 D1 P M1 G2 R2 S
Natabhairavi.explanation: The 20th Melakarta raga and the natural minor scale of world music, parent to Bhairavi, Hindolam, and Darbari.

Nawakouns.name: Nawakouns
Nawakouns.arohana: S G2 M1 D1 N2 S'
Nawakouns.avarohana: S' N2 D1 M1 G2 S
Nawakouns.explanation: A modern modification of Malkauns popularized in Malayalam cinema by M. Jayachandran.

Niroshta.name: Niroshta
Niroshta.arohana: S R2 G3 D2 N3 S'
Niroshta.avarohana: S' N3 D2 G3 R2 S
Niroshta.explanation: Literally 'Without Lips' (Nir-Oshta) created by Muthiah Bhagavathar; sung without lips touching as Ma and Pa are omitted!

Panthuvarali.name: Panthuvarali
Panthuvarali.arohana: S R1 G3 M2 P D1 N3 S'
Panthuvarali.avarohana: S' N3 D1 P M2 G3 R1 S
Panthuvarali.explanation: The 51st Melakarta raga, highly venerated for saintly prayer and temple rituals.

Patdeep.name: Patdeep
Patdeep.arohana: S G2 M1 P N3 S'
Patdeep.avarohana: S' N3 D2 P M1 G2 R2 S
Patdeep.rasaOrMood: Deep Passion, Tender Longing, Bright Joy
Patdeep.explanation: Resembles Bhimpalasi but features Shuddha Nishad, giving it an unmistakable glowing brightness.

Peelu.name: Peelu
Peelu.arohana: S G3 M1 P N3 S'
Peelu.avarohana: S' N2 D2 P M1 G2 R2 S
Peelu.explanation: One of the most expressive, free-flowing folk scales in Indian cinema and light music.

Poorvi Kalyani.name: Poorvi Kalyani
Poorvi Kalyani.arohana: S R1 G3 M2 P D2 P S'
Poorvi Kalyani.avarohana: S' N3 D2 P M2 G3 R1 S
Poorvi Kalyani.explanation: Celebrated Carnatic raga featuring Prati Madhyamam with a vakra ascent on Panchama.

Poorvi Kamboji.name: Poorvi Kamboji
Poorvi Kamboji.arohana: S R2 G3 M1 P D2 S'
Poorvi Kamboji.avarohana: S' N2 D2 P M1 G3 R2 S
Poorvi Kamboji.explanation: Traditional Kathakali and classical dance padam scale.

Punnagavaraali.name: Punnagavaraali
Punnagavaraali.arohana: N2' S R1 G2 M1 P D1 N2
Punnagavaraali.avarohana: N2 D1 P M1 G2 R1 S N2'
Punnagavaraali.explanation: Classic Nishadantya raga historically associated with snake charmers (Magudi) and deep sorrow.

Ranjani.name: Ranjani
Ranjani.arohana: S R2 G2 M2 D2 S'
Ranjani.avarohana: S' N3 D2 M2 G2 S R2 S
Ranjani.explanation: An enchanting Shadava-Audava raga omitting Panchamam, famous for G.N.B's 'Durmarga Chara'.

Rasikapriya.name: Rasikapriya
Rasikapriya.arohana: S R3 G3 M2 P D3 N3 S'
Rasikapriya.avarohana: S' N3 D3 P M2 G3 R3 S
Rasikapriya.explanation: The 72nd and final Melakarta in the Carnatic system with all sharpest swara variants.

Rasikaranjani.name: Rasikaranjani
Rasikaranjani.arohana: S R2 G3 P D2 S'
Rasikaranjani.avarohana: S' D2 P G3 R2 S
Rasikaranjani.explanation: Pentatonic janya omitting Madhyamam and Nishadam.

Rathipathipriya.name: Rathipathipriya
Rathipathipriya.arohana: S R2 G2 M2 P N2 S'
Rathipathipriya.avarohana: S' N2 P M2 G2 R2 S
Rathipathipriya.explanation: Audava-Audava scale omitting Dhaivatam, used by Ilayaraja for 'Varna Vrindavanam'.

Ravichandrika.name: Ravichandrika
Ravichandrika.arohana: S R2 G3 M1 D2 S'
Ravichandrika.avarohana: S' N2 D2 M1 G3 R2 S
Ravichandrika.explanation: Thyagaraja's 'Niravadhi Sukhada' is famously composed in Ravichandrika.

Revagupthi.name: Revagupthi
Revagupthi.arohana: S R1 G3 P D1 S'
Revagupthi.avarohana: S' D1 P G3 R1 S
Revagupthi.explanation: Identical notes to Bowli in ascent and descent, beloved in Malayalam temple classics.

Revathi.name: Revathi
Revathi.arohana: S R1 M1 P N2 S'
Revathi.avarohana: S' N2 P M1 R1 S
Revathi.explanation: A deeply spiritual, austere pentatonic scale used for chants and cosmic hymns.

Rishabapriya.name: Rishabapriya
Rishabapriya.arohana: S R2 G2 M2 P D1 N2 S'
Rishabapriya.avarohana: S' N2 D1 P M2 G2 R2 S
Rishabapriya.explanation: The 62nd Melakarta raga with Prati Madhyamam and Suddha Dhaivatam.

Rishivani.name: Rishivani
Rishivani.arohana: S R2 G3 M2 P D2 N3 S'
Rishivani.avarohana: S' N3 D2 P M2 G3 R2 S
Rishivani.explanation: Epic raga featured in Pazhassi Raja's 'Aadiyushassandhya' composed by Ilayaraja.

Rudrapriya.name: Rudrapriya
Rudrapriya.arohana: S R2 G2 M1 P D2 N2 S'
Rudrapriya.avarohana: S' N2 P M1 G2 R2 S
Rudrapriya.explanation: Thyagaraja's 'Lavanya Rama' is immortalized in this scale.

Rugmambari.name: Rugmambari
Rugmambari.arohana: S R1 G3 M2 P D2 S'
Rugmambari.avarohana: S' D2 P M2 G3 R1 S
Rugmambari.explanation: Popularized by Raveendran Master in Lal Salaam for 'Aadi druthapada thaalam'.

Saaramathi.name: Saaramathi
Saaramathi.arohana: S R2 G2 M1 P D1 N2 S'
Saaramathi.avarohana: S' N2 D1 M1 G2 S
Saaramathi.explanation: Thyagaraja's 'Mokshamu Galada' immortalized this hauntingly beautiful raga.

Saaranga.name: Saaranga
Saaranga.arohana: S R2 G3 M2 P D2 N3 S'
Saaranga.avarohana: S' N3 D2 P M2 R2 G3 M1 R2 S
Saaranga.explanation: A beloved bhashanga raga featuring both Shuddha Ma and Prati Ma.

Sahana.name: Sahana
Sahana.arohana: S R2 G3 M1 P M1 D2 N2 S'
Sahana.avarohana: S' N2 S' D2 P M1 G3 M1 R2 G3 R2 S
Sahana.explanation: One of the most delicate and moving ragas in Carnatic music with characteristic andolan on Gandhara.

Samanthamalahari.name: Samanthamalahari
Samanthamalahari.arohana: S R2 M1 P D1 S'
Samanthamalahari.avarohana: S' D1 P M1 R2 S
Samanthamalahari.explanation: Immortalized in Devaasuram's 'Vande Mukunda' and G. Aravindan's Kummatti.

Sarasangi.name: Sarasangi
Sarasangi.arohana: S R2 G3 M1 P D1 N3 S'
Sarasangi.avarohana: S' N3 D1 P M1 G3 R2 S
Sarasangi.explanation: The 27th Melakarta raga, combining Sankarabharanam's purvanga with Mayamalavagowla's uttaranga.

Saraswathi.name: Saraswathi
Saraswathi.arohana: S R2 M2 P D2 S'
Saraswathi.avarohana: S' N2 D2 P M2 R2 S
Saraswathi.explanation: Dedicated to the Goddess of Learning and Music, omitting Gandharam.

Saveri.name: Saveri
Saveri.arohana: S R1 M1 P D1 S'
Saveri.avarohana: S' N3 D1 P M1 G3 R1 S
Saveri.explanation: A major morning raga expressing deep surrender and heartfelt prayer.

Savithri.name: Savithri
Savithri.arohana: S G3 M1 P D2 N2 S'
Savithri.avarohana: S' N2 D2 P M1 G3 S
Savithri.explanation: Melodious Janya scale of the Harikambhoji family.

Shanmukhapriya.name: Shanmukhapriya
Shanmukhapriya.arohana: S R2 G2 M2 P D1 N2 S'
Shanmukhapriya.avarohana: S' N2 D1 P M2 G2 R2 S
Shanmukhapriya.rasaOrMood: Supreme Lord Muruga's Grace, Spiritual Yearning, Majesty
Shanmukhapriya.explanation: The 56th Melakarta, one of the most widely used and majestic Prati Madhyama ragas in South India.

Shudh Sarang.name: Shudh Sarang
Shudh Sarang.arohana: S R2 M1 P N3 S'
Shudh Sarang.avarohana: S' N3 D2 P M2 P M1 R2 S
Shudh Sarang.explanation: Classic afternoon raga using both Shuddha Ma and Teevra Ma in graceful alternation.

Shyam Kalyan.name: Shyam Kalyan
Shyam Kalyan.arohana: S R2 M2 P N3 S'
Shyam Kalyan.avarohana: S' N3 D2 P M2 P G3 M1 R2 S
Shyam Kalyan.explanation: A regal Hindustani evening melody merging Kalyan with delicate Shuddha Ma.

Shyama.name: Shyama
Shyama.arohana: S R2 M1 P D2 S'
Shyama.avarohana: S' D2 P M1 G3 R2 S
Shyama.explanation: Celebrated for its tranquilizing, sedative melody; capable of soothing troubled minds.

Simhendra Madhyamam.name: Simhendra Madhyamam
Simhendra Madhyamam.arohana: S R2 G2 M2 P D1 N3 S'
Simhendra Madhyamam.avarohana: S' N3 D1 P M2 G2 R2 S
Simhendra Madhyamam.rasaOrMood: Deep Mystery, Heroic Pathos, Royal Grace
Simhendra Madhyamam.explanation: The 57th Melakarta raga, famous for its lion-like grandeur and intense emotional scope.

Sourashtram.name: Sourashtram
Sourashtram.arohana: S R1 G3 M1 P M1 D2 N3 S'
Sourashtram.avarohana: S' N3 D2 N2 D1 P M1 G3 R1 S
Sourashtram.explanation: A revered auspicious bhashanga raga traditionally sung at mangalams and temple weddings.

Sreeranjini.name: Sreeranjini
Sreeranjini.arohana: S R2 G2 M1 D2 N2 S'
Sreeranjini.avarohana: S' N2 D2 M1 G2 R2 S
Sreeranjini.explanation: Shadava-Shadava raga omitting Panchamam, famous for Thyagaraja's 'Marubalka Kuntevira'.

Sudha Bangala.name: Sudha Bangala
Sudha Bangala.arohana: S R2 M1 P D2 S'
Sudha Bangala.avarohana: S' D2 P M1 R2 G2 R2 S
Sudha Bangala.explanation: Thyagaraja's 'Ramabhakti Samrajyam' is immortalized in this vibrant scale.

Sudha Dhanyasi.name: Sudha Dhanyasi
Sudha Dhanyasi.arohana: S G2 M1 P N2 S'
Sudha Dhanyasi.avarohana: S' N2 P M1 G2 S
Sudha Dhanyasi.rasaOrMood: Soothing Shringara, Tender Devotion, Melodic Peace
Sudha Dhanyasi.explanation: One of the most beloved pentatonic ragas in Indian music, omitting Ri and Dha.

Sumaneesha Ranjani.name: Sumaneesha Ranjani
Sumaneesha Ranjani.arohana: S R2 G2 M1 P D2 N2 S'
Sumaneesha Ranjani.avarohana: S' N2 D2 P M1 G2 R2 S
Sumaneesha Ranjani.explanation: Invented/popularized in Malayalam cinema music by Sharreth and Raveendran Master.

Surutti.name: Surutti
Surutti.arohana: S R2 M1 P N2 S'
Surutti.avarohana: S' N2 D2 P M1 G3 P M1 R2 S
Surutti.explanation: An ancient, highly auspicious vakra raga frequently used for padams, javalis, and concluding prayers.

Swarabhooshini.name: Swarabhooshini
Swarabhooshini.arohana: S R2 G2 M1 P D2 N2 S'
Swarabhooshini.avarohana: S' N2 D2 P M1 R2 S
Swarabhooshini.explanation: Thyagaraja's 'Varadaraja Ninnu' is composed in this scale.

Thodi.name: Thodi
Thodi.arohana: S R1 G2 M1 P D1 N2 S'
Thodi.avarohana: S' N2 D1 P M1 G2 R1 S
Thodi.explanation: The grandest morning raga of Carnatic music, capable of immense, hours-long classical elaboration.

Ushaanipadam.name: Ushaanipadam
Ushaanipadam.arohana: S R2 G2 M1 P D2 N2 S'
Ushaanipadam.avarohana: S' N2 D2 P M1 G2 R2 S
Ushaanipadam.explanation: Historic scale documented in 1950s Malayalam cinema compositions.

Vachaspathi.name: Vachaspathi
Vachaspathi.arohana: S R2 G3 M2 P D2 N2 S'
Vachaspathi.avarohana: S' N2 D2 P M2 G3 R2 S
Vachaspathi.explanation: The 64th Melakarta raga, corresponding to the Acoustic scale (Lydian Dominant).

Vakulaabharanam.name: Vakulaabharanam
Vakulaabharanam.arohana: S R1 G3 M1 P D1 N2 S'
Vakulaabharanam.avarohana: S' N2 D1 P M1 G3 R1 S
Vakulaabharanam.explanation: The 14th Melakarta raga with Suddha Rishabham and Kaisiki Nishadham.

Vanaspathi.name: Vanaspathi
Vanaspathi.arohana: S R1 G1 M1 P D2 N2 S'
Vanaspathi.avarohana: S' N2 D2 P M1 G1 R1 S
Vanaspathi.explanation: The 4th Melakarta raga in the Carnatic system.

Vasantha.name: Vasantha
Vasantha.arohana: S M1 G3 M1 D2 N3 S'
Vasantha.avarohana: S' N3 D2 M1 G3 R1 S
Vasantha.rasaOrMood: Spring Blossom, Auspicious Joy, Festive Evening
Vasantha.explanation: One of the most joyous evening ragas of Carnatic music, omitting Panchama.

Vasanthabhairavi.name: Vasanthabhairavi
Vasanthabhairavi.arohana: S R1 G3 M1 D1 N2 S'
Vasanthabhairavi.avarohana: S' N2 D1 M1 G3 R1 S
Vasanthabhairavi.explanation: Famous for Thyagaraja's 'Nee Dayarada', omitting Panchamam.

Vasanthasree.name: Vasanthasree
Vasanthasree.arohana: S M1 G3 M1 D2 N3 S'
Vasanthasree.avarohana: S' N3 D2 M1 G3 R1 S
Vasanthasree.explanation: A melodic variant of Vasantha featured in Raveendran Master's Abhimanyu classical bit.

Vasanthi.name: Vasanthi
Vasanthi.arohana: S R2 G3 M1 P D1 S'
Vasanthi.avarohana: S' D1 P M1 G3 R2 S
Vasanthi.explanation: Shadava-Shadava raga omitting Nishadam, heavily featured in Malayalam film songs.

Velavali.name: Velavali
Velavali.arohana: S R2 G2 M1 P D2 S'
Velavali.avarohana: S' D2 P M1 G2 R2 S
Velavali.explanation: Used by Naushad Ali in Dhwani for 'Anuraagalola'.

Vijayanaagari.name: Vijayanaagari
Vijayanaagari.arohana: S R2 G2 M2 P D2 S'
Vijayanaagari.avarohana: S' D2 P M2 G2 R2 S
Vijayanaagari.explanation: A spirited pentatonic raga with Prati Madhyamam, omitting Nishadam.

Vilasini.name: Vilasini
Vilasini.arohana: S R2 G3 P D2 S'
Vilasini.avarohana: S' N2 D2 P G3 R2 S

Vrindavana Saranga.name: Vrindavana Saranga
Vrindavana Saranga.arohana: S R2 M1 P N3 S'
Vrindavana Saranga.avarohana: S' N2 P M1 R2 S
Vrindavana Saranga.rasaOrMood: Joyous Love, Krishna's Flute, Pastoral Romance
Vrindavana Saranga.explanation: Associated with Lord Krishna in Vrindavan; employs Kakali Ni in ascent and Kaisiki Ni in descent.

Yadukula Kamboji.name: Yadukula Kamboji
Yadukula Kamboji.arohana: S R2 M1 P D2 S'
Yadukula Kamboji.avarohana: S' N2 D2 P M1 G3 R2 S
Yadukula Kamboji.rasaOrMood: Deep Compassion, Tender Pleading, Folk Warmth
Yadukula Kamboji.explanation: Beloved ancient folk and classical scale with serene oscillations on Rishabham and Dhaivatam.

Kaapi.name: Kaapi
Kaapi.arohana: S R2 M1 P N3 S'
Kaapi.avarohana: S' N2 D2 N2 P M1 G2 R2 S
Kaapi.explanation: A highly expressive vakra bhashanga raga capable of inducing deep devotion and melancholy.

Kharaharapriya.name: Kharaharapriya
Kharaharapriya.arohana: S R2 G2 M1 P D2 N2 S'
Kharaharapriya.avarohana: S' N2 D2 P M1 G2 R2 S
Kharaharapriya.explanation: One of the grandest Major Melakartas of Carnatic music, mother of Abheri, Kapi, and Darbari Kanada.

Mohanam.name: Mohanam
Mohanam.arohana: S R2 G3 P D2 S'
Mohanam.avarohana: S' D2 P G3 R2 S
Mohanam.explanation: The quintessential Audava-Audava pentatonic scale omitting Ma and Ni, universally known and loved.

Kalyani.name: Kalyani
Kalyani.arohana: S R2 G3 M2 P D2 N3 S'
Kalyani.avarohana: S' N3 D2 P M2 G3 R2 S
Kalyani.explanation: One of the most celebrated and royal ragas of Indian music, employing Teevra/Prati Madhyamam.

Sankarabharanam.name: Sankarabharanam
Sankarabharanam.arohana: S R2 G3 M1 P D2 N3 S'
Sankarabharanam.avarohana: S' N3 D2 P M1 G3 R2 S
Sankarabharanam.explanation: Major scale of Indian music named after Lord Shiva ('Ornament of Sankara').

Hindolam.name: Hindolam
Hindolam.arohana: S G2 M1 D1 N2 S'
Hindolam.avarohana: S' N2 D1 M1 G2 S
Hindolam.explanation: Ancient pentatonic raga omitting Ri and Pa, known as Malkauns in the North.

Sudha Saveri.name: Sudha Saveri
Sudha Saveri.arohana: S R2 M1 P D2 S'
Sudha Saveri.avarohana: S' D2 P M1 R2 S
Sudha Saveri.explanation: Audava-Audava pentatonic scale omitting Ga and Ni, equivalent to Hindustani Durga.

Madhyamavathi.name: Madhyamavathi
Madhyamavathi.arohana: S R2 M1 P N2 S'
Madhyamavathi.avarohana: S' N2 P M1 R2 S
Madhyamavathi.explanation: An auspicious pentatonic raga traditionally performed at the conclusion of Carnatic concerts.

Sindhu Bhairavi.name: Sindhu Bhairavi
Sindhu Bhairavi.arohana: S R2 G2 M1 P D1 N2 S'
Sindhu Bhairavi.avarohana: S' N2 D1 P M1 G2 R1 S
Sindhu Bhairavi.explanation: A versatile bhashanga scale incorporating all 12 notes in semi-classical bhajans and cinema melodies.

Sivaranjani.name: Sivaranjani
Sivaranjani.arohana: S R2 G2 P D2 S'
Sivaranjani.avarohana: S' D2 P G2 R2 S
Sivaranjani.explanation: Five-note pentatonic scale identical to Mohanam except with Sadharana Gandharam (G2 / Komal Ga).

Charukesi.name: Charukesi
Charukesi.arohana: S R2 G3 M1 P D1 N2 S'
Charukesi.avarohana: S' N2 D1 P M1 G3 R2 S
Charukesi.explanation: The 26th Melakarta uniting Sankarabharanam's lower half with Natabhairavi's upper half.

Hamsadhwani.name: Hamsadhwani
Hamsadhwani.arohana: S R2 G3 P N3 S'
Hamsadhwani.avarohana: S' N3 P G3 R2 S
Hamsadhwani.rasaOrMood: Joy, Radiant Vigor, Sacred Invocation (Vatapi Ganapatim)
Hamsadhwani.explanation: Created by Ramaswami Dikshitar, the sound of the divine swan (Hamsa-Dhwani).

Malayamarutham.name: Malayamarutham
Malayamarutham.arohana: S R1 G3 P D2 N2 S'
Malayamarutham.avarohana: S' N2 D2 P G3 R1 S
Malayamarutham.explanation: Named after the soothing southern mountain breeze (Malaya-Marutham), omitting Madhyamam.

Jog.name: Jog
Jog.arohana: S G3 M1 P N2 S'
Jog.avarohana: S' N2 P M1 G3 M1 G2 S
Jog.explanation: Masterpiece raga popularized in Kerala cinema by Raveendran Master in 'Pramadavanam'.

Subha Panthuvarali.name: Subha Panthuvarali
Subha Panthuvarali.arohana: S R1 G2 M2 P D1 N3 S'
Subha Panthuvarali.avarohana: S' N3 D1 P M2 G2 R1 S
Subha Panthuvarali.explanation: Major Prati Madhyama Melakarta with deep spiritual gravity.

Arabhi.name: Aarabhi
Arabhi.arohana: S R2 M1 P D2 S'
Arabhi.avarohana: S' N3 D2 P M1 G3 R2 S
Arabhi.explanation: One of the five major Ghana ragas of Carnatic music. Featured in Saint Thyagaraja's Pancharatna Kriti 'Sadhinchane'.

Keeravani.name: Keeravani
Keeravani.arohana: S R2 G2 M1 P D1 N3 S'
Keeravani.avarohana: S' N3 D1 P M1 G2 R2 S
Keeravani.explanation: The 21st Melakarta corresponding to the Harmonic Minor scale in Western classical music.

Kurinji.name: Kurinji
Kurinji.arohana: S N3 S R2 G3 M1 P D2
Kurinji.avarohana: D2 P M1 G3 R2 S N3 S
Kurinji.explanation: Classic lullaby raga characterized by peaceful, comforting notes.

Maand.name: Maand
Maand.arohana: S G3 M1 P D2 S'
Maand.avarohana: S' N3 D2 P M1 G3 R2 S
Maand.explanation: Celebrated Rajasthani folk scale popular in semi-classical thumri and cinema.

Madhyamaadi Saarang.name: Madhyamavathi
Madhyamaadi Saarang.arohana: S R2 M1 P N2 S'
Madhyamaadi Saarang.avarohana: S' N2 P M1 R2 S
Madhyamaadi Saarang.explanation: An auspicious pentatonic raga traditionally performed at the conclusion of Carnatic concerts.

Mayamalava Gowla.name: Mayamalava Gowla
Mayamalava Gowla.arohana: S R1 G3 M1 P D1 N3 S'
Mayamalava Gowla.avarohana: S' N3 D1 P M1 G3 R1 S
Mayamalava Gowla.explanation: The foundation scale of beginner Carnatic music formulated by Purandara Dasa.

Neelambari.name: Neelambari
Neelambari.arohana: S R2 G3 M1 P D2 P N3 S'
Neelambari.avarohana: S' N3 P M1 G3 R2 G3 S
Neelambari.explanation: The queen of lullabies in Indian music.

Pahadi.name: Pahadi
Pahadi.arohana: S R2 G3 P D2 S'
Pahadi.avarohana: S' N3 D2 P M1 G3 R2 S
Pahadi.explanation: Himalayan folk melody famous for romantic and serene cinema songs.

Pushpalathika.name: Pushpalathika
Pushpalathika.arohana: S R2 G2 M1 P N2 S'
Pushpalathika.avarohana: S' N2 P M1 G2 R2 S
Pushpalathika.explanation: Shadava-Shadava scale omitting Dhaivata, celebrated in 'Kalabham Tharaam'.

Reethigowla.name: Reethigowla
Reethigowla.arohana: S G2 R2 G2 M1 N2 D2 M1 N2 N2 S'
Reethigowla.avarohana: S' N2 D2 M1 G2 M1 P M1 G2 R2 S
Reethigowla.explanation: Intricate vakra raga with unmistakable oscillations on Gandhara and Nishada.

Valachi.name: Valachi
Valachi.arohana: S G3 P D2 N2 S'
Valachi.avarohana: S' N2 D2 P G3 S
Valachi.explanation: Pentatonic raga omitting Ri and Ma, very popular in Malayalam cinema.

Yamuna Kalyani.name: Yamuna Kalyani
Yamuna Kalyani.arohana: S R2 G3 P M2 P D2 S'
Yamuna Kalyani.avarohana: S' D2 P M2 P G3 M1 G3 R2 S
Yamuna Kalyani.explanation: A variation of Kalyani enriched by the inclusion of Shuddha Madhyamam.

Jogeshwari.name: Jogeshwari
Jogeshwari.arohana: S G3 M1 P N2 S'
Jogeshwari.avarohana: S' N2 P M1 G3 M1 G2 S
Jogeshwari.explanation: Masterpiece raga popularized in Kerala cinema by Raveendran Master in 'Pramadavanam'.
